_spec: AN ALTERNATIVE FOR THE OWNER, NOT THE FILM — marked rehearsal, so it is written to preview-rehearsal.mp4 and verify says so. storyboard-scenes.json with S6 brought back from take5b, the keyed take of 2026-10-14, on the reading that S6's rule protects the salon's phone rather than the « Contact » block: the scroll is 290 pt, not short; it shows the map, the address, « WhatsApp » and the hours; the phone row is masked. S5 is out, by storyboard-scenes.json's own rule (« the first to drop if the film is over 30 s »: with it this cut is 32.633 s). If the owner chooses it, it becomes storyboard-scenes.json, without `rehearsal`.
_never_shown: sign-in; « Mon abonnement » or an offer; KYC (« Vérification »); a « Compte de démonstration — … » message; a system alert; a legible phone number; the « Prestations » price list as a scene. Checked by eye on the frames and by OCR of every decoded frame; the tool reads none of it.
